fields.name: AdvancedStashStackable
fields.note: According to Phrozen Keep member Yupgoolg, you need to also edit layout/bankexpansionlayouthd.json in order for the item to actually show up in the stash tab.

tableNotes.note: If the associated skill's $!#ItemTarget#!$ is set to 4, the game will crash upon loading.

fields.name: spawnable
fields.note: If this field is enabled, the item can still be created using the Horadric Cube.

fields.name: cost
fields.note: The rarity of the item has no bearing on the cost. This base cost is modified by the 'Reduced Vendor Costs' property and the costs of each stat as defined in $!itemstatcost!$.

fields.name: auto prefix
fields.note: This description is inaccurate - it applies to normal (white/grey) items as well, and it doesn't replace random prefixes - it adds to them. This column needs to be set in order for automagic to work properly.

fields.name: stackable
fields.note: Not all items can be stacked if this property is turned on. Notably, gems/runes will crash the game if they are inserted into an item while they have a quantity.

fields.name: Transmogrify
fields.note: The Transmogrify behavior is unused in the base game, and is a relic from the alpha version of Diablo II, which allowed for the conversion of organs (dropped items) into various utility items. When Transmogrify is enabled, the item will get a piece of text in its tooltip, stating 'Right Click to Convert to X' and it will transform into another item. **Transmogrify only works on legacy versions of the game.**

fields.name: bitfield1
fields.note: This can be used to control which items can be consumed to make an Iron Golem.

fields.name: normcode
fields.note:
This column doesn't exist by default in misc.txt. It can be safely added.
An item must have an entry in this column if it can be gambled, otherwise the game will crash. (Rings and amulets are a hardcoded exception.)

fields.name: item#
fields.note: 'mul', 'ma' and 'mg' function identically. 'cu', 'cs', 'cr', 'cm', 'ce', and 'cg' are in 1024ths - a value of 512 will cause the quality to appear 50% of the time.

fields.name: mon#
fields.note: In the legacy version of the game, only mon1-mon10 are present in the MPQ but the columns mon11-mon25 can be added to the file and work correctly. In Resurrected, all 25 columns are present in Blizzard's files.
